title: Define staged gating matrix and cross-team acceptance for regional routing PRD
creator: Marin Alvarez
description: Summary: This ticket creates a staged gating matrix and sign-off playbook for the Regional Routing & Fallbacks PRD (handles routing requests across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with automatic fallbacks when regional capacity is constrained). Purpose: reduce ambiguity during PRD review by making clear acceptance lanes for Engineering (runtime/infra), Design (Console + UX messaging), and Legal (data residency/KMS). Scope: gating lanes (alpha beta GA), explicit checklist per lane, owner and SLA for sign-off, and artifact links for each decision. Out-of-scope: implementation work; this ticket only defines acceptance criteria and the handoff/runbook for sign-off approvals.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering lane: runtime performance contract defined (99th p90 latency target, throughput baseline) and a compatibility matrix documenting fallback models/variants
Engineering lane: integration tests and canary plan described with required dashboards (latency, error-rate, failover-count) and GitHub PR template
Design lane: Console UX for routing controls and fallback messaging mocked, accessibility checks listed, and copy for user-facing error states reviewed
Legal lane: data residency decision matrix completed (region -> storage / KMS mapping), required contracts or export-control notes captured, and an initial security checklist signed by Security
Gate checklist: for each release stage (alpha,beta,GA) there is a named owner, minimum telemetry signals, rollback criteria, and a documented acceptance vote with timestamped sign-off artifacts
All lanes: a canonical Confluence PRD link, a rollout timeline, and a list of dependent Linear tickets are attached and referenced in the sign-off artifact

decisions: Use staged lanes: alpha (internal), beta (select customers), GA (all customers) with separate acceptance gates
Fallback behavior: prefer model-variant fallback over region-level reroute for single-request latency-sensitive paths
Console UX: show fallback indicator with expand-to-details modal that lists why fallback happened and whether data left the region

Data residency: persistent logs will be stored in customer-chosen region; ephemeral KV caches may be replicated per-region with policy flags; legal approved this approach subject to KMS key residency mapping
